title: P112 rank-57 cover with scoped rational decoder cost floors
body:
The original PR2041 cover has strict scalar fitting rank 99. This contribution changes the cover of the same 112 selected labels and certifies minimum scalar fitting rank **57**, with explicit factors and a matching identity minor. It also proves why minimizing that rank does not produce an affordable decoder under the full port-space tariff:

- **Exactly 57 rational rank-one terms cost at least 334**, over every fitting matrix on this mask. The saved construction attains 334, so this floor is sharp. It includes asymmetric factors and arbitrary nonzero common normalization.
- **Any number of terms costs at least 308** when the fitted matrix has rank 57 and both factor families remain in its column and row spaces. For `m=57+s`, the proof gives `C >= max(334-s, 228+3s)`. The bound 308 is not claimed attainable.

Both floors exceed the favorable positive-saving allowance `2672/9` (integer charge at most 296). A successful scalar decoder therefore needs at least 58 terms and either exterior factor directions that cancel in the sum or a higher-rank fitting matrix. Those possibilities, changed covers and operator contracts remain open. **No native supplier, selected-result change or exponent improvement is claimed.**

The new proof uses the forced identity minor and Schur complement to characterize every rank-57 fit, then duality for the sharp minimum-length bound. Its extension uses a complete 40-space support closure and an acyclic-subset argument to limit discounts from extra factors. Rational coefficients are not reduced modulo two; binary linear algebra is used only for group geometry and pricing. See [the complete proof](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1c7bdd4575137b3334adb185ec8f7efb63584b9e/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/RANK-TIGHT-PROOF.md) for the complete assumptions and argument.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rational-decoder-gate
```

All five registered commands pass under `-I -O -B`. Independent implementations check the 12,544 rational endpoint coefficients, full-group tariffs, 324 enlarged support pairings and all 40 generated spaces/272 discounted rectangles. Dense rational fixtures have uncancelled even denominators. Controls reject forbidden-edge changes, original-label underpricing, residual corruption and incomplete span closures. Three separate AI agents audited the proof and scope; this is not human review or proof-assistant verification. Bounded exterior-direction and higher-rank motif searches found no cheaper construction; those searches are not impossibility claims.

Task `coverage-law-change`, explicitly changed scope, with the family budget and next questions in [TASK.json](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1c7bdd4575137b3334adb185ec8f7efb63584b9e/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/TASK.json) and [README.md](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1c7bdd4575137b3334adb185ec8f7efb63584b9e/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/README.md). The construction's scientific pins are retained. This cost follow-up began on canonical main `936fac15b1b1b59dc5285c713a77f9f3c07b2906` and was tested against refreshed main `8e22a9d9f621c72ab5b299061c2be4c7f638fd3c`; guidance, selected record and consumed inputs were unchanged. Latest 100 updated open PR bodies were checked at 20:57 UTC on 2026-10-15. Discussion refresh stopped on HTTP 406; earlier cached discussions and fresh local notes were used, so overlap coverage is bounded.

Credit is retained for Cinna Davis (#2041/#2126), Adam Gall (#1889), Sagar Thakrar (#2532 and the different-mask rank certificate #2484), ywz65 (#2471), ctoth and collaborators, Philippe Van Velzen, Jeremy Diviney (#2203), icekylinx, woklerx, and the selected PR1094 source lineage. Exact pins and distinctions are in the package. Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, proof, implementation and independent-agent checking. Apache-2.0.

Published head `1c7bdd4575137b3334adb185ec8f7efb63584b9e`: all 12 package files were fetched back and matched the tested local files byte-for-byte.
